items.title: Orchestrate DuckDB analytics pipelines with Amazon MWAA
items.summary: Learn how to orchestrate embedded DuckDB analytics pipelines with Amazon MWAA. This post shows how to run DuckDB inside Airflow tasks to read Parquet data from Amazon S3, apply time-effective model rates, and publish Apache Iceberg tables to Amazon S3 Tables, with retry-safe publishing and worker-sizing considerations.
items.creator: Vinod Jayendra
categories: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)

items.title: Introducing Amazon OpenSearch Memory: Persistent memory for AI agents
items.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Memory is now generally available. Built on Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, it adds persistent, cross-session memory to AI agents. It stores interactions as searchable events, derives memories, and retrieves relevant context, so you can give agents long-term memory without building your own memory system.
items.creator: Ganesh Natarajan
